parsed.rationale: I can't call this normal: the rhythm is regular at about 90 bpm, and V1–V3 show widened, notched rSR'-type QRS complexes with secondary T-wave inversion in the right precordial leads (RBBB). There is no ST elevation meeting STEMI criteria, and the baseline is noisy.
